Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDP.xlsx · evaluates: The GDP.xlsx card describes task-specific rubrics assessing output accuracy, completeness and appropriateness.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdp-xlsx.rubric.v3

  • The card does not document a complete human authoring or adjudication procedure.

GDP.xlsx · benchmark task: GDP.xlsx tasks pair a workplace-style request with input Excel or CSV files; its documented Harbor packaging combines task instructions, inputs and evaluation logic for isolated container execution.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdp-xlsx.task-package.v2

  • This describes the pinned public card, not an executed Harbor run or inspection of all 70 tasks.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDP.xlsx · access terms: The pinned GDP.xlsx card declares Apache-2.0 in its metadata while its benchmark-use notice directs exclusion from training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, distillation and checkpoint selection.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdp-xlsx.use-constraints.v2

  • Both statements are retained together as creator-published terms; this is not a legal reconciliation or blanket rights clearance.
  • The benchmark-use restriction is not generalized to unrelated Surge datasets.
